description: This file contains functions and constants for validating, normalizing, and managing runtime options for a session, including handling configuration inputs, merging options, and generating signatures.

methods.name: failInvalidOption
methods.description: Throws an AcpRuntimeError indicating an invalid runtime option.

methods.name: validateNoControlChars
methods.description: Checks that a string does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validateBoundedText
methods.description: Validates that a text is non-empty, within max length, and free of control characters.

methods.name: validateBackendOptionKey
methods.description: Validates that a backend option key is within length limits and matches allowed characters.

methods.name: validateBackendOptionValue
methods.description: Validates that a backend option value is within length limits.

methods.name: validateRuntimeModeInput
methods.description: Validates runtime mode input string.

methods.name: validateRuntimeModelInput
methods.description: Validates runtime model ID string.

methods.name: validateRuntimePermissionProfileInput
methods.description: Validates permission profile string.

methods.name: validateRuntimeCwdInput
methods.description: Validates working directory path, ensuring it is absolute.

methods.name: validateRuntimeTimeoutSecondsInput
methods.description: Validates timeout seconds as a number within allowed range.

methods.name: parseRuntimeTimeoutSecondsInput
methods.description: Parses and validates timeout seconds from raw input.

methods.name: validateRuntimeConfigOptionInput
methods.description: Validates key and value for runtime configuration options.

methods.name: validateRuntimeOptionPatch
methods.description: Validates and applies a patch to runtime options.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns undefined if not a string.

methods.name: normalizeRuntimeOptions
methods.description: Normalizes runtime options by trimming and filtering.

methods.name: mergeRuntimeOptions
methods.description: Merges current runtime options with a patch, normalizing the result.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeOptionsFromMeta
methods.description: Resolves runtime options from session metadata, considering cwd.

methods.name: runtimeOptionsEqual
methods.description: Checks equality of two runtime options objects.

methods.name: buildRuntimeControlSignature
methods.description: Builds a string signature representing runtime control options.

methods.name: buildRuntimeConfigOptionPairs
methods.description: Generates key-value pairs for runtime configuration.

methods.name: inferRuntimeOptionPatchFromConfigOption
methods.description: Infers runtime option patch from a configuration key-value pair.
